meta.title: feat(cpu-threading): integrate CLI with threading system and unify TTS API
meta.body_summary: Integrate CLI modes with CPU threading optimization, unify TTS API by removing old constructor, add logging, fix chunking bounds, document benchmarks.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code authored CPU threading optimization and API unification with benchmark table; PR open awaiting maintainer review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 739 changed lines across 13 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume. As an open performance optimization PR, it has not yet been reviewed or merged; the change includes substantial refactoring and API breaking change.

review_details.concern_detail: No reviews have been submitted; only author comments exist.
review_details.performance_claim: Improved TTS latency and throughput via CPU core distribution across ONNX Runtime instances, with benchmark showing 4-instance optimal at 13.7s total time.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Low-level inference threading optimization requires understanding of ONNX Runtime threading model and memory bandwidth; Agent provided benchmark data and infrastructure changes that need maintainer validation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Benchmark table provided but no step-by-step instructions to reproduce the exact environment; claim based on manual testing with potential environment variability.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored TTS engine creation to accept instance count, implemented CPU core distribution for ONNX Runtime threading, added mimalloc, logging system, CLI speed parameter, chunking boundary fix, and unified API.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Dependency management, documentation, and test files; no runtime monitoring changes.
